gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-telug: Noto Sans Telugu reads briskly, its counters open to the outside. Funnel Display, drawn like a neon sign tube of single width, leads the page with a loud top line.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-thai: Inflated, bead-like lowercase gives the body a friendly read, a soft foil for Funnel Display and its ruler-drawn line. Noto Sans Thai stays open and soft beside that rigid stroke.

gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-tifin: Funnel Display looks marker-drawn, each stroke a spaghetti strand with capitals barely rising above the lowercase. Noto Sans Tifinagh adds inflated, open bowls, and that puffed-up softness is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-tirhu: Expressive from the first glance, Funnel Display keeps one unmodulated line across every glyph. Noto Sans Tirhuta is the plain sans for the quiet job, cutting terminals back to leave big gaps.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-stack-sans-headline: A clear channel leads into each round letter of Autour One, which also skips any hairline-to-stem shift. Stack Sans Headline, a monoline sans-serif, feels sturdy and approachable beside it.
